# llms.txt - AI discoverability for prasen.dev

> Prasenjit Nayak's personal portfolio and technical blog.

## About

Prasenjit Nayak is a Full Stack Developer from Odisha, India, specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. He builds modern web applications, contributes to open source, and writes about web development.

Since June 2025 he has run Grind n Shine, a 500+ member WhatsApp community for developers, community builders and recruiters. Invites on request via hi@prasen.dev.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.prasen.dev): Portfolio homepage with projects, skills, work experience, and social links.
- [Blog](https://www.prasen.dev/blog): Technical articles about web development, React, Next.js, AI tools, and software engineering.
- [Projects](https://www.prasen.dev/projects): Web applications and open source projects.
- [Videos](https://www.prasen.dev/videos): YouTube videos about software development and technology.
- [Gadgets](https://www.prasen.dev/gadgets): Developer tech setup, PC components, and productivity tools.

## Projects

Products Prasenjit built and runs.

- [Outbuilt](https://outbuilt.lol): A pay-to-rank public leaderboard, no logins, no algorithms, your rank is what you paid for. 23 paid placements across 11 countries after launch on Aug 22, 2026.
- [Dateup](https://dateup.in): AI dating profile optimizer: Grok generates the photos, OpenAI handles scoring and openers. 155K+ Google impressions and 1.2K+ clicks in its first 4 months per Search Console, growing from 13K to 49K impressions a month.
- [PayBrackets](https://paybrackets.com): A free US take-home pay calculator for the 2026 tax year covering all 50 states and D.C., 160+ programmatic pages. 777 users from 42 countries in the last 90 days.
- [Wallpaperz](https://www.wallpaperz.in): Wallpaper discovery platform with AI generation, monetized with AdSense. 600 to 800 page views a day 20 months after launch, visitors from 110+ countries. 31+ GitHub stars.
- [CleanType](https://cleantype.is-a.software): A distraction-free Windows writing app in Rust and Tauri. 337+ downloads across 4 releases, 21+ GitHub stars.
- [Next.js Learning Platform](https://learn.prasen.dev): A free, open source Next.js course with 17 structured chapters. 25+ GitHub stars.

## Lab (AI-built demos, directed and shared on X)

Browser 3D demos and one video that Prasenjit directed AI models (mostly Claude) to build, then shared on X. The code was written by the AI; the stats below are GitHub stars and X post reach.

- [Jungle Trail](https://starknightt.github.io/jungle-trail/): A fully procedural first-person jungle in Three.js with zero external art assets. 296+ GitHub stars, 44 forks. The performance debug overlay was a PR from the CTO of Xbox.
- [Night Street](https://night-street.vercel.app): A photorealistic procedural city street at golden hour, walkable in the browser with zero external assets. 123+ GitHub stars, 19 forks. Featured by the official Claude account on X.
- [Sedona Sunset](https://starknightt.github.io/sedona-sunset/): A first-person walk up a dry wash between red rock buttes at golden hour, plain Three.js with no build step, around 26,000 lines, every mesh, texture and sound generated in code, zero external assets. 35+ GitHub stars, 7 forks. Launch post 66K+ views, reposted by the official Claude account (75K+ views).
- [PRESS START](https://x.com/prasenx/status/2103851939457093635): A 2-minute cinematic trailer on the history of video games where every frame and every note is generated in code, GLSL shaders drawn on the GPU, music synthesized in Python, stitched with ffmpeg, no footage, images or samples. Built with Claude Opus 5.5 in Cursor. Reposted by Elon Musk. Making of: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXl_BnG2hzs
- [Summer Cycle](https://starknightt.github.io/summer-cycle/): A toon-shaded bike ride down a Japanese country road in the style of a Ghibli or Makoto Shinkai background painting, built in Three.js with Claude Opus 5.5. Every mesh, texture, shop sign and sound generated in code. 39+ GitHub stars, 14 forks. Launch post 65K+ views, 1.2K+ likes.
- [Bay Ride](https://starknightt.github.io/bay-ride/): A summer evening in a painted seaside bay in Three.js, walk the pier and the beach, then take a wooden skiff out to the lighthouse island while the day runs from morning to a moonlit night. Sea, sky, town, trees, birds, every sound and the piano score generated in code at load time, ink and Kuwahara paint filter. The one authored model is the heroine, built by a Python script in Blender. Built with Claude Opus 5.5 in Cursor.
- [Operation Ironhold](https://starknightt.github.io/operation-ironhold/): A complete first-person shooter in a single 290 KB HTML file, no build step, no asset files, Three.js from a CDN. 4 weapons with ADS, recoil and reloads, 10 AI enemies that flank and take cover, sniper scope with breath hold. Built with Claude Opus 5 from five prompts. 97+ GitHub stars, 25 forks. Launch post 80K+ views, 790+ likes.
- [Backrooms: Level 0](https://backroom-escape.vercel.app): A browser survival horror game with fully procedural assets and A* pathfinding AI. 24+ GitHub stars, 10 forks. The prototype that led to Jungle Trail and Night Street.
- [Gas Station at Dawn](https://starknightt.github.io/gas-station-highway/): A photorealistic first-person gas station at dawn, pump fuel, open the store door, grab a drink from the cooler. Three.js and TypeScript, 81 files, zero external assets, three quality tiers. 13+ GitHub stars. Launch post 20K+ views.
- [Tactical FPS in the browser](https://starknightt.github.io/counter-strike-in-browser/): A Counter-Strike inspired bomb-site map in the browser with 5 bots, bomb plant and defuse, HUD, GTAO, bloom and sun shafts, on Three.js and three-mesh-bvh. The one project that uses real assets: map, weapons and hands modelled by scripts in Blender via Blender MCP and exported to GLB, Poly Haven textures, CC0 audio. Built with Claude Opus 5 and Fable 5.1. 11+ GitHub stars. Launch post 19K+ views.
- [Parapet](https://starknightt.github.io/parapet/): First-person rooftop parkour, vault, slide, wall-run and wall-jump across a procedural brutalist city at golden hour. Three.js and TypeScript, around 4,800 lines, everything generated at runtime, city rendered in a handful of draw calls, 30-check Playwright playtest bot. Launch post 7.6K+ views.
- [3D Carousel Gallery](https://3dcarousell.vercel.app): Interactive 3D carousel built with pure CSS 3D transforms, no Three.js. 43+ GitHub stars, 6 forks.

## Technical Stack

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
Frontend: React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion
Backend: Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis
Tools: Git, Docker, Cursor, Claude
